name: hgi_sm_xl2_bdring-cl2d-COMMIT
purpose: x-load cl2 leaf (H-SM 2026-10-15): the flat clock-leaf cl failed its --cts gate (multiple_cts_roots source on 32 SRAMs; bs_a 8,642 / md 5,635 / bq_v 4,125-load nets; bw->rq 21 levels). cl2 = cluster of hardened leaves (ctl, 4 x BF quarter of one master, 2 x the CLOSED tree13 quantiser tile, BD ring), one clock root each < 15k sinks, every leaf pin registered (owner 19:50), running issue-word registers (no multiply), replicated selects; +2 fixed edges on every xw beat (lock bench vs cl shifted 2).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hgi_sm_xload_cl2_bdring u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/peers/ot_hgi_sm_xload_static_cl2.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hgi_sm_xl2_bdring/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hgi_sm_xl2_bdring/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hgi_sm_xl2_bdring --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hgi_sm_xload_cl2_bdring  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: cl2d (native audit of CLOSED cl2c, TT +10.45/FF +15.02/DRC 0: capture 511.7 ps on 18 pins, launch 392.9 ps on 30 pins): (1) r_wsel/zlo/zhi gated the 32 x 266 ring storage straight from the pins -> ctl now sends them ONE edge early (lookahead on its fixed tag delay line qt[QL-2]) and the ring leaf captures them in pin registers on the same edge as wr_lo/wr_hi (one enable copy per parity): ring write edge, every xw beat and x_done unchanged (lock bench vs cl shifted 2; new MUT5 = no lookahead must FAIL); (2) the 2,048 bq_d output flops + hold pads packed 4 deep on a 216-um E face (red strip, failing launch pins clustered bq_d[1380..1432]) -> outline 172.8 x 302.4 (E face +40 %, area 52.3k vs 46.7k um2, fill ~20 %).
